_comment: Agent -> class. Status follows ADR-005: 'confirmed' needs a source in evidence, 'unverified' means recalled from general knowledge and still needs a source. Update status in place; never delete an agent. Agents not listed, or with class null, are left out of class comparisons. Last sourced 2026-10-30. Roles can change in later patches; recheck when a new build is processed.
